mapper.insert: insert into region_daily_stat ( stat_date, region_id, sido_name, `name`, total_sites, total_target, completed_target, cumulative_completed_target, total_reports, completed_reports, pending_reports, refused_reports, issue_reports_count, create_time ) select #{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} as stat_date, fr.region_id, fr.sido_name, fr.name, coalesce(s_agg.total_sites, 0) as total_sites, coalesce(s_agg.total_target, 0) as total_target, coalesce(r_agg.completed_target, 0) as completed_target, coalesce(c_agg.cumulative_completed_target, 0) as cumulative_completed_target, coalesce(r_agg.total_reports, 0) as total_reports, coalesce(r_agg.completed_reports, 0) as completed_reports, coalesce(r_agg.pending_reports, 0) as pending_reports, coalesce(r_agg.refused_reports, 0) as refused_reports, coalesce(r_agg.issue_reports_count, 0) as issue_reports_count, now() as create_time from fire_region fr left join ( select s.region_id, count(distinct s.site_id) as total_sites, count(h.household_id) as total_target from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id where s.region_id is not null and s.region_id != '' group by s.region_id ) s_agg on fr.region_id = s_agg.region_id left join ( select coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) as region_id, count(distinct case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then coalesce(wr.household_id, wr.report_id) end) as completed_target, count(*) as total_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 end) as completed_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'PENDING' then 1 end) as pending_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'REFUSED' then 1 end) as refused_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'PENDING' and wr.remarks is not null and trim(wr.remarks) != '' and wr.remarks not like '%특이사항 없음%' then 1 end) as issue_reports_count from work_report wr left join site s on wr.site_id = s.site_id left join household hh on wr.household_id = hh.household_id left join site s_hh on hh.site_id = s_hh.site_id where wr.delete_flg = 0 and date(coalesce(wr.report_time, wr.create_time)) = #{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} and coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) is not null and coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) != '' group by coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) ) r_agg on fr.region_id = r_agg.region_id left join ( select coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) as region_id, count(distinct coalesce(wr.household_id, wr.report_id)) as cumulative_completed_target from work_report wr left join site s on wr.site_id = s.site_id left join household hh on wr.household_id = hh.household_id left join site s_hh on hh.site_id = s_hh.site_id where wr.delete_flg = 0 and wr.status = 'COMPLETED' and date(coalesce(wr.report_time, wr.create_time)) <= #{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} and coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) is not null and coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) != '' group by coalesce(s.region_id, s_hh.region_id) ) c_agg on fr.region_id = c_agg.region_id on duplicate key update sido_name = values(sido_name), `name` = values(`name`), total_sites = values(total_sites), total_target = values(total_target), completed_target = values(completed_target), cumulative_completed_target = values(cumulative_completed_target), total_reports = values(total_reports), completed_reports = values(completed_reports), pending_reports = values(pending_reports), refused_reports = values(refused_reports), issue_reports_count = values(issue_reports_count), create_time = values(create_time)
mapper.select: select stat_date, region_id, sido_name, `name`, total_sites, total_target, completed_target, cumulative_completed_target, total_reports, completed_reports, pending_reports, refused_reports, issue_reports_count, create_time from region_daily_stat where stat_date = #{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} order by sido_name asc, `name` asc

select max(stat_date) as stat_date, region_id, sido_name, `name`, max(total_sites) as total_sites, max(total_target) as total_target, sum(completed_target) as completed_target, max(cumulative_completed_target) as cumulative_completed_target, sum(total_reports) as total_reports, sum(completed_reports) as completed_reports, sum(pending_reports) as pending_reports, sum(refused_reports) as refused_reports, sum(issue_reports_count) as issue_reports_count, max(create_time) as create_time from region_daily_stat where stat_date >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} and stat_date <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} group by region_id, sido_name, `name` order by sido_name asc, `name` asc
